input: Fix a typo in the error message in src/auth/login.py: 'Invalid credientials' should be 'Invalid credentials'.
Extract the retry logic duplicated in src/api/client.py, src/api/uploader.py, and src/api/downloader.py into a shared src/api/retry.py helper. No behavior change.
Update README.md to document the new --dry-run flag added to the CLI in the last release.

Change the signature of parse_config(path) to parse_config(path, strict=False) in src/config.py and update the one caller in src/main.py. Existing callers passing a second positional argument will break.
Bump the requests dependency from 2.31.0 to 2.32.3 in requirements.txt to pick up a security fix (CVE-2024-35195).
Add a --json output flag to the CLI: new flag defined in src/cli.py, new formatter in src/formatters/json_formatter.py, updated src/main.py to wire it in, and added tests in tests/test_cli.py.
Rename the 'data' variable to 'payload' across 12 files in src/handlers/ for consistency with the rest of the codebase. Purely mechanical, no logic changes.
Revert commit a1b2c3d ('feat: enable experimental caching layer') because it caused intermittent test failures in CI.
